name: YouTube API Metadata
description: Provides YouTube metadata (title, description, thumbnails, channel info, stats) via the official YouTube Data API v3, without depending on yt-dlp. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.x; not compatible with Jellyfin 12.x.
overview: YouTube metadata provider using the official YouTube Data API v3

versions.changelog: Ported to Jellyfin 12.0 (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Data 12.0.0). Drops Jellyfin 10.11.x support.
